behavioral_notes.observation: When a chatter upload is flagged cloud_storage=True, _post_add_create sets type='cloud_storage', clears raw bytes (raw=False), and stores only the provider blob URL in the url field. On download, _to_http_stream returns Stream(type='url', url=signed_url) with max_age derived from time_to_expiry-10, so the Odoo server redirects the browser directly to the cloud provider — it never streams the blob bytes itself.

Extends the mail attachment upload route. For cloud_storage requests it first creates the ir.attachment record via super() (with an empty stub body), then calls attachment._generate_cloud_storage_upload_info() and appends the returned upload_info dict to the JSON response. The browser JS then PUTs the real file bytes directly to the cloud provider URL — the Odoo server is never in the upload data path.

Downloads a cloud blob via requests.get(download_url, timeout=10), raises_for_status(), and rewrites the attachment as type='binary', url=False, raw=response.content. This migration helper prevents data loss when the cloud_storage_provider is changed, by repatriating blobs back to the Odoo filestore before the provider switch is committed.

Injects cloud_storage_min_file_size (int, bytes) and cloud_storage_unsupported_models (list of model names) into the browser session payload whenever cloud_storage_provider is set. The OWL AttachmentUploadService patch reads these values client-side to decide whether to route a given file through the cloud path. Models inheriting mail.thread.main.attachment or documents.mixin are excluded from cloud offload via _get_cloud_storage_unsupported_models().

set_values enforces a provider-switch guard: if cloud_storage_provider was already set and is changing, _check_cloud_storage_uninstallable() is called first. After saving, if _get_cloud_storage_configuration() returns an empty dict (provider credentials incomplete), a UserError is raised. Only a valid non-empty configuration triggers _setup_cloud_storage_provider(). All three methods are designed as overridable stubs for concrete provider modules (cloud_storage_google, cloud_storage_azure, etc.).

3 JS files, 2 XML templates, 0 OWL components; 3 patches: AttachmentUploadService._upload sends a dummy empty File body to Odoo for large files and stores the real File in uploadingCloudFiles; _processLoaded issues a cloud PUT via XMLHttpRequest using upload_info.method/url/headers; Chatter and Composer patches adapt the flow for the public portal chatter.

it_architecture.application: cloud_storage (Technical Settings — provider-agnostic cloud attachment offload framework)
software_services: /mail/attachment/upload (CloudAttachmentController override — returns upload_info for direct browser-to-cloud PUT)
data_objects: ir.attachment (extended: type selection adds 'cloud_storage'; url stores blob URL; raw=False for cloud type)
information_flows: upload path: browser -> Odoo (stub ir.attachment + upload_info) -> browser XHR PUT -> cloud provider
download path: browser -> /web/content/<id> -> Odoo 302 redirect to signed cloud URL -> cloud provider
migration path: _migrate_remote_to_local downloads blob and resets type=binary

capabilities: Offload chatter/mail attachment blobs to external cloud object storage
Configure per-system minimum file-size threshold (default 20 MB) for cloud vs. local routing
Protect records requiring local attachment data (documents.mixin, mail.thread.main.attachment) from cloud offload
Migrate cloud attachments back to local filestore on provider change
value_streams: Attachment lifecycle: upload -> cloud blob storage -> signed-URL serve -> optional local repatriation
policies: Files smaller than cloud_storage_min_file_size (default 20 MB) are stored locally in the Odoo filestore
Models inheriting mail.thread.main.attachment or documents.mixin are excluded from cloud offload
Provider switch is blocked unless _check_cloud_storage_uninstallable() passes (no stranded blobs)
stakeholders: System administrator (configures provider credentials and file-size threshold)
End users (upload/download attachments transparently via chatter)

classification.rationale: cloud_storage is a pure IT infrastructure capability: it offloads binary blobs from the Odoo filestore to external cloud object storage. It has no business-process models, no business logic, and no direct user-facing value stream; it exists solely to reduce storage cost and I/O load on the Odoo server. This maps to APQC 8.0 Manage Information Technology — infrastructure management. The baseline used 13.0 (Develop and Manage Business Capabilities) which was incorrect.

standard_capabilities: Provider-agnostic upload/download URL generation (abstract hooks _generate_cloud_storage_upload_info / _generate_cloud_storage_download_info in ir.attachment)
Client-side file-size threshold routing via OWL AttachmentUploadService patch
Session-info injection of cloud config parameters to the OWL frontend
Provider-switch guard with local repatriation helper (_migrate_remote_to_local)
typical_fits: Standard chatter attachments (mail.thread) are offloaded transparently once a provider module is installed
Standard /web/content download route automatically issues signed-URL redirects
common_gaps: No concrete provider built in — cloud_storage_google or cloud_storage_azure must be installed separately
No bulk migration UI — _migrate_remote_to_local is a per-record helper, not an admin wizard
Documents app (documents.mixin) records are explicitly excluded from cloud offload by design
drive_hints: curl /web/content/<attachment_id> to observe the 302 redirect to a signed cloud URL
